answer: Mustard seed and wine vinegar wait on the mustard-maker's bench, the millstones clean. ledge winnows the seed and picks out the husks. Proof of mustard-maker via ground mustard tally — a pot the mustard-maker grinds only after 1483 pots bite true without one pot turning at the lid, each ground by the mustard-maker himself. falcon grinds the seed fine and stirs in the vinegar. horizon pots the mustard and seals each jar with wax. One thousand four hundred and eighty-three pots must bite true without one pot turning at the lid, and the next still turns where the seed ran stale.
